description: This Java class defines a service for managing root cause analysis (RCA) data related to defects, specifically implementing 5 Whys analysis. It provides methods to retrieve, create/update, and delete RCA entries associated with defect IDs.

classes.name: RcaService
classes.description: Service class for managing root cause analysis data using 5 Whys methodology.

methods.name: getByDefectIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the RCA for a given defect ID, or null if none exists.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates an RCA record for a specific defect based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteByDefect
methods.description: Deletes the RCA record associated with a specific defect ID.
